It addresses the intractability of explicit volumetric resampling on a hemisphere by using a differentiable hierarchical approach, distinct from the 1D ray sampling used in NeRF [S1].

The evidence explicitly states that previous volume-based methods use 'explicit volumetric representation with a fixed resolution, making resampling on the hemisphere intractable.' It further contrasts NeTF's approach by stating, 'To make this problem tractable, we develop a coarse-to-fine sampling scheme' and notes that 'our hierarchical sampling is intrinsically differentiable.' Finally, it explicitly distinguishes this from NeRF: 'NeRF calculates the integral along a ray, i.e., using 1D sampling, whereas NeTF on a hemisphere, i.e., using 2D sampling.' All components of the claim are directly supported by the text.
